title: Smokies, S'mores, Mulled Wine and Fall Fun at Kelowna Winery
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Fun for everyone! This family-friendly event is a unique experience on a scenic farm in beautiful South East Kelowna. 
Guests will get the opportunity to explore a Kelowna artisan farm in the Fall! Guests will be led through an informative honey wine tasting and a specialty-infused honey tasting with one of our experienced staff members, and afterwards, enjoy a family-friendly scavenger hunt around the farm with the opportunity to win prizes!

A gourmet lunch of Artisan Honey Smokies served with local ingredients and treats will be provided as well as a glass of warm Mulled Mead or Hot Chocolate can be enjoyed around the fire on our rustic hay bale seating as you roast your own marshmallows to build your own s'mores!
